description: Huawei Cloud CTS (Cloud Trace Service / 云审计服务) management and audit analysis via hcloud CLI. Covers tracker lifecycle (list/create/delete), audit trace query and analysis (filter by time/user/ service), cloud service operation listing, key event notifications, trace resources, and retention compliance analysis (7-day default vs LTS long retention vs OBS delivery). Query and Analyze actions run automatically (R3); Create/Delete actions require preview and explicit user confirmation (R2/R1). Supports AK/SK credentials and local hcloud profile authentication. Triggers include: CTS, Cloud Trace Service, 云审计服务, audit log, 审计日志, tracker, 追踪器, trace, 审计事件, operation record, 操作记录, notification, 通知规则, retention, 保留策略, compliance, 合规, audit, 审计.
